description: This file defines a helper utility class `PartyTypeHelper` in the `org.apache.ofbiz.party.party` package. It provides a static method `checkPartyType` to verify if a given party (by ID) matches a specific party type (e.g., PERSON or PARTY_GROUP) within the OFBiz framework, utilizing entity query utilities and type checking.

classes.name: PartyTypeHelper
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for checking party types within OFBiz.

methods.name: checkPartyType
methods.description: Checks whether the party with the given partyId is of the specified party type (e.g., PERSON or PARTY_GROUP). Returns false if the party does not exist, an error occurs, or the party type does not match.
